title: Binding Affinity Prediction with 3D Machine Learning: Training Data and Challenging External Testing
authors: Jose Carlos Gómez-Tamayo; Lili Cao; Mazen Ahmad; Gary Tresadern
one_liner_zh: 该文聚焦蛋白-配体结合亲和力预测的3D机器学习方法，对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白-DNA互作，方法虽涉及AI但体系与TF-DNA无关，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Protein-ligand binding affinity prediction is one of the major challenges in computational assisted drug discovery. An active area of research uses machine learning (ML) models trained on 3D structures of protein ligand complexes to predict binding modes, discriminate active and inactives, or predict affinity. Methodological advances in deep learning, and artificial intelligence along with increased experimental data (3D structures and bioactivities) has led to many studies using different architectures, representation, and features. Unfortunately, many models do not learn details of interactions or the underlying physics that drive protein-ligand affinity, but instead just memorize patterns in the available training data with poor generalizability and future use. In this work we incorporate “dense”, feature rich datasets that contain up to several thousand analogue molecules per drug discovery target. For the training set, PDBbind dataset is used with enrichment from 8 internal lead optimization (LO) datasets and inactive and decoy poses in a variety of combinations. A variety of different model architectures was used and the model performance was validated using the binding affinity for 12 internal LO and 6 ChEMBL external test sets. Results show a significant improvement in the performance and generalization power, especially for virtual screening and suggest promise for the future of ML protein-ligand affinity prediction with a greater emphasis on training using datasets that capture the rich details of the affinity landscape.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质-配体结合亲和力预测是计算辅助药物发现中的主要挑战之一。一个活跃的研究领域利用机器学习（ML）模型，这些模型基于蛋白质-配体复合物的三维结构进行训练，以预测结合模式、区分活性分子与非活性分子，或预测亲和力。深度学习和人工智能的方法论进展，加上实验数据（三维结构和生物活性）的增加，催生了许多采用不同架构、表示和特征的研究。遗憾的是，许多模型并未学习到驱动蛋白质-配体亲和力的相互作用细节或底层物理原理，而仅仅是在可用训练数据上记忆模式，导致泛化能力差，未来应用受限。在本工作中，我们整合了“密集”、特征丰富的数据集，这些数据集包含每个药物发现靶点的多达数千个类似物分子。对于训练集，使用PDBbind数据集，并通过8个内部先导优化（LO）数据集以及非活性和诱饵姿态的多种组合进行丰富。采用了多种不同的模型架构，并使用12个内部LO和6个ChEMBL外部测试集的结合亲和力验证了模型性能。结果显示，在性能和泛化能力方面有显著提升，尤其是在虚拟筛选方面，并预示着未来ML蛋白质-配体亲和力预测的前景，更侧重于使用捕捉亲和力景观丰富细节的数据集进行训练。
